title: FAR Module 4 · TBS 5

fields.label: 4. Other Financing Source From Bond Proceeds

html:
TASK-BASED SIMULATION

Integrated Governmental Analysis

Apply multiple governmental accounting concepts in one year-end simulation.

Scenario

The City of Fairview reports the following information for the current year.

Item 1 — Fund Classification

The city operates a public parking garage that primarily charges external customers for usage.

Enter: 1 = Enterprise Fund, 2 = Internal Service Fund, 3 = General Fund.

Item 2 — Property Tax Revenue

The General Fund has $950,000 of measurable property taxes.

Of that amount, $70,000 does not meet the government's availability criterion.

Item 3 — Capital Asset Purchase

The General Fund purchases equipment for $160,000.

Enter the amount reported as a governmental fund expenditure.

Item 4 — Bond Proceeds

The General Fund receives $300,000 from issuance of general long-term bonds.

Enter the amount reported as an other financing source.

Item 5 — Government-Wide Reconciliation

The governmental funds report a $500,000 increase in fund balance.

This amount includes:

  • Capital outlay: $160,000
  • Bond proceeds: $300,000

Government-wide depreciation expense is $40,000.

Ignore all other reconciling items.

Required

1. Fund Classification Code
2. Property Tax Revenue Recognized
3. Capital Outlay Expenditure
4. Other Financing Source From Bond Proceeds
5. Government-Wide Change in Net Position
explanation:
Item 1 — Fund Classification

The parking garage primarily serves external customers and charges users for services.

Enterprise Fund = Code 1

Item 2 — Property Tax Revenue

Governmental fund revenue must generally be measurable and available.

$950,000 − $70,000 Unavailable = $880,000 Revenue

Item 3 — Capital Outlay

The General Fund generally reports the equipment purchase as an expenditure.

Capital Outlay Expenditure = $160,000

Item 4 — Bond Proceeds

General long-term bond proceeds are generally reported as an other financing source in governmental funds.

Other Financing Source = $300,000

Item 5 — Government-Wide Reconciliation

Increase in Fund Balance $500,000 + Capital Outlay $160,000 − Depreciation $40,000 − Bond Proceeds $300,000 = $320,000 CHANGE IN NET POSITION

Module 4 Final Takeaway

  • Enterprise funds generally serve external users.
  • Modified accrual revenue requires measurable + available.
  • Governmental fund capital purchases are generally expenditures.
  • Bond proceeds are other financing sources in governmental funds.
  • Government-wide reporting removes governmental-fund financing effects and recognizes capital assets and depreciation.
